steps.clickAt: (()=>{const L=document.querySelector('[aria-label="造型 A 设定图候选"]'); const w=[...L.querySelectorAll('.hub-candw')].find(w=>!w.querySelector('.hub-cand.on')); const b=w.querySelector('.hub-cand'); b.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__ua_target=w.querySelector('img')?.alt; return [r.x+r.width/2, r.y+r.height/3]})()

steps.js: const dlg=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog], .ds-modal, [class*=lightbox], [class*=big]')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>200); return {target: window.__ua_target, openDialogs: dlg.map(d=>({cls:d.className, txt:d.innerText.slice(0,120), img: !!d.querySelector('img')}))}
